verifications.source_title: Meta-Harness: End-to-End Optimization of Model Harnesses

verified_claims.claim: Raw execution traces substantially outperform scores-only and scores+LLM-summary interfaces in the online text-classification ablation.
verified_claims.location: paper Table 3 / ablation of proposer information
verified_claims.assessment: Worker values match the primary table. The paper explicitly interprets raw execution-trace access as the key ingredient; summary-only does not recover the lost diagnostic signal.

verified_claims.claim: Meta-Harness reaches 48.6% average test accuracy on the three searched text-classification datasets versus ACE 40.9%, with 11.4K versus 50.8K context tokens.
verified_claims.location: paper text-classification results table / abstract summary
verified_claims.assessment: Verified from the primary paper summary/table. Scope is the reported three classification datasets and their evaluation protocol.

verified_claims.claim: A single discovered math-retrieval harness improves average accuracy from 34.1% to 38.8% (+4.7 points) across five evaluated models.
verified_claims.assessment: Verified. The worker wording 'previously unseen IMO-level problems' is consistent with the paper's 200-problem evaluation; model-transfer scope should remain limited to the five reported models and benchmark construction.

verified_claims.claim: TerminalBench-2 reports 76.4% with Opus 4.6 and 37.6% with Haiku 4.5, versus Terminus-KIRA 74.7% and Goose 35.5%, respectively.
verified_claims.location: paper TerminalBench-2 table (Table 5 in OpenReview version / Table 7 in another version)
verified_claims.assessment: Verified. The paper also explicitly states search and final evaluation use the same TerminalBench-2 benchmark and calls the resulting harness specialized to that regime; therefore this must not be presented as held-out generalization.

corrections_or_clarifications.current_worker_wording: self-improvement systems should persist queryable raw diagnostic experience
corrections_or_clarifications.verified_scope: Strong direct ablation support exists for the Meta-Harness online text-classification search interface. Transfer to arbitrary self-improvement systems remains a mechanism hypothesis, not a directly established universal rule.

Benchmark-specialized only. Search and final evaluation share the same 89-task TerminalBench-2 benchmark; leakage audits were performed, but there is no independent held-out benchmark split in that experiment.

unresolved_gaps: Primary-table cross-check for the worker's exact OOD classification statement 73.1% vs 70.2% and best-on-6/9 was not completed in this run from the primary PDF text extraction, although secondary summaries are consistent with it.
No independent replication was verified here; this file verifies the authors' primary reported evidence only.

verifications.source_title: AutoDesign: Meta-Harness Optimization for Long-Horizon Agentic Design

verified_claims.claim: Each outer-loop update changes exactly one of five harness components and candidate acceptance requires training improvement with no development-set decline; development trajectories are hidden from the proposer.
verified_claims.location: official AutoDesign README method summary; paper method section
verified_claims.assessment: Verified. The acceptance rule and single-component restriction are explicitly stated by the authors.

verified_claims.claim: Across seven matched model–coding-agent configurations, attaching DesignHarness improves PosterBench-mini score in every case by +5.01 to +19.56 points.
verified_claims.location: official AutoDesign README, DesignHarness benefit / small-scale benchmark
verified_claims.assessment: Worker examples and reported gain range match the official authors' repository.

verified_claims.claim: The seven-configuration average improves from 54.99 to 67.39 (+12.40 points).
verified_claims.location: paper/project summary and author-posted benchmark summary

verified_claims.claim: AutoDesign main-track score is 78.32, 7.45 points above Claude Design at 70.87 under the stated comparison.
verified_claims.location: official AutoDesign README main benchmark table

verified_claims.claim: The system was evolved over 7 days with 224 subagents, at least 123 recursive iterations, and 54 accepted harness updates.

corrections_or_clarifications.current_worker_wording: bounded single-component updates + a hidden development no-regression gate enable interpretable recursive harness evolution
corrections_or_clarifications.verified_scope: The paper states the single-component restriction is intended to keep credit assignment interpretable, but it does not provide a matched multi-component ablation establishing that this restriction causally improves credit assignment or overall performance. Treat the rationale as design motivation, not isolated efficacy evidence.
The quantitative gains are within the paper-to-poster / PosterBench setting and matched model–coding-agent configurations. Do not transfer the +5.01 to +19.56 range to general agentic tasks.

unresolved_gaps: The worker's human-evaluation detail '64.0% Bradley–Terry estimate with 95% interval 55.2–77.8 across 933 valid ranking judgments' was not fully primary-table cross-checked in this run; author/project summaries support the 64.0% and 933-judgment claims, but the exact interval should remain pending until directly checked in the paper table.
No independent replication was verified here; this file verifies the authors' primary/official reported evidence only.

downstream_action.integrator: May treat C5 raw-trace ablation and C6 matched DesignHarness gains/acceptance rule as primary-verified within the exact scopes above. Must retain the TerminalBench specialization caveat and the lack of a direct single-vs-multi-component ablation.
downstream_action.evidence_comparator: May upgrade confidence in the cited primary claims, while keeping independent-replication status separate and unresolved.

next_verification: Primary-verify self_improvement/C7 (RSEA) strict held-out gate versus no-gate and WebShop negative-transfer scope, then self_improvement/C4 (KSI) exact quantitative tables.
